protocol.noise_bank_construction: one torch.Generator(cpu) seeded NOISE_BANK_SEED per training seed; at each rollout step it draws N_NOISE tensors of shape (num_envs, horizon, transition_dim) in order; index i is reused verbatim by every arm
protocol.within_run: Isaac Gym/DLP observations are not bit-reproducible across processes; all endpoints and ground-truth futures used in paired comparisons are generated inside this single run
